## Core Value Proposition & Factory Branding Standards
- **140 Deduplicated, IP-Safe Ready Metal Molds (`FS-001` to `FS-150`)**: Cleaned from 148 production rows (duplicate #147 merged into FS-135; out-of-stock #65 archived; multi-material molds FS-114/115/132, FS-105/106, FS-107/112, FS-030/031, FS-094/095 unified with tier selectors).
- **$0.00 Tooling / Mold Fee**: All 140 models use mature production molds ready for immediate blank dispatch (MOQ 50 pcs, 3–7 business days) or custom logo branding (MOQ 100 pcs, 10–15 business days).
- **Recommended Metal Branding Processes (Why We Do Not Recommend Surface Silk-Screen / UV Ink)**: Polished, electroplated, anodized, and PVD-coated metal surfaces are ultra-smooth and chemically inert, causing surface-printed ink to peel under thumb friction. Instead, our factory recommends:
  1. **50W MOPA Fiber Laser Engraving**: `+$0.15 – $0.30 USD/pc` (MOQ 100 pcs, $0 setup fee, paid pre-production sample: `$50 USD`, 10–15 days).
  2. **Deep Laser Engraving + Color Fill (Recessed Enamel Infill)**: `+$0.35 – $0.60 USD/pc` (MOQ 100–200 pcs, paid pre-production sample: `$80 – $150 USD`, 10–15 days).
- **US CPSC 16 CFR 1262 & EU RoHS/REACH Compliant**: Captive blind counterbores, two-part structural epoxy (>22 MPa), and thread-locked M2/M2.5 fasteners prevent magnet detachment.
